title: cerastium soleirolii subsp. stenopetalum
intro: Cerastium soleirolii subsp. stenopetalum, commonly known as Snow-in-Summer, is a flowering plant species belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Snow-in-Summer include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties, making it a useful treatment for minor cuts and scrapes. The bioactive constituents of Cerastium soleirolii subsp. stenopetalum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
